# photoZseo

> photoZseo (App Store name: "photoZseo: SEO Product Photo") is an iPhone and iPad app for online sellers. It turns one product photo into marketplace-ready images and listing text for 46 marketplaces: it resizes, compresses and SEO-renames photos, removes backgrounds on the device, fills in titles, descriptions, tags and alt text, and exports CSV/XLSX listing files. Free to download on the App Store with a free plan; paid plans from $9.99/month. Requires iOS / iPadOS 17 or later. Not available for Android or Mac.

Last updated: 2026-11-26. All prices in USD; the App Store shows local prices.

## Key facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762639768 (app ID 6762639768, category Business).
- Devices: iPhone (iOS 17.0+) and iPad (iPadOS 17.0+). One subscription covers both with the same Apple Account. No Android, no Mac version yet.
- Languages (15): English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Persian, Urdu.
- Marketplaces: image presets for 46 marketplaces and 60+ export targets in total including social and ad channels. Examples: Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, Walmart, WooCommerce, Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Çiçeksepeti, AliExpress, Temu, SHEIN, DHgate, Mercado Libre, Allegro, Zalando, Otto, Kaufland, Noon, Shopee, Lazada, Coupang, Flipkart; Instagram, TikTok Shop, Pinterest, Facebook Shops, WhatsApp Catalog.
- Listing files: CSV / XLSX / JSON in each platform's column layout (49 platform formats), per product or combined; import from CSV, TSV, XLSX, JSON or photo URLs.
- Camera: template camera for 7 angles (front, back, side, detail, top, label, lifestyle), auto-zoom, HDR, live text recognition, 4K, volume-button shutter.
- SEO: 13 fields (SEO title, slug, file name, category, meta description, description, alt text, 4 tags, keywords, barcode) in 15 languages. On iOS 26 with Apple Intelligence the text is written by Apple's on-device Foundation Models; on iOS 17–25 by on-device image analysis and templates.
- Background removal: on-device (Apple Vision); transparent PNG, white or custom color; batch.
- Other: EXIF editor (GPS removed on export by default), JPEG/PNG/WebP, B2B PDF quote builder (VAT, IBAN, Incoterms, HS codes, e-signature), Shopify product push, online store on photozseo.com, iCloud Drive sync, teams.
- Privacy: photos are processed on the device, no ads, no advertising ID; anonymous usage analytics (Firebase) can be turned off in Settings. Subscriptions via App Store / RevenueCat.
- Works offline except publishing (Shopify, online store), iCloud sync and purchases.

## Pricing

- Free ($0): template camera, all image sizes and formats, 5 active platforms, 3 photo imports per month from Photos/Files (camera shots unlimited); exports carry a watermark.
- Starter: $9.99/month or $71.99/year. No watermark, batch export and sharing, video recording, 15 active platforms, 100 imports per month.
- Pro: $19.99/month or $143.99/year. Everything in Starter plus all platforms, AI background removal (100/month), AI alt text, online store on photozseo.com, 1,000 imports per month.
- Business: $49.99/month or $359.99/year. Everything in Pro plus unlimited imports and background removal, B2B quote builder, Shopify integration, create a team (up to 3 members).
- Annual plans cost 40% less than monthly and include a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in iPhone Settings → [name] → Subscriptions.

## Chrome extension (separate product)

photoZseo for Chrome is a separate desktop product, not the iPhone & iPad app: a Chrome side-panel extension that collects product photos and details from the product page you are viewing, resizes and compresses photos to marketplace requirements, gives them SEO file names and exports a ZIP plus CSV or Excel files.

- [Install from the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/photozseo/hmmeomfepgjaplheiolbibfkdbooioce): the extension is live.
- [photoZseo Chrome extension](https://photozseo.com/chrome-extension): Features, pricing, privacy and FAQ (15 languages).
- Browser: Google Chrome 116+ on Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS (uses the side panel; not on mobile).
- 82 resize and compression profiles for 67 platforms; ZIP by category / product / platform; 50 platform CSV formats plus Shopify, Trendyol and Hepsiburada spreadsheets.
- No account and no photoZseo backend; library stored locally in IndexedDB. Background removal is not included (it is in the iPhone & iPad app).
- Pricing: Free (5 products, 10 new images per day, 4 image sizes). Pro $7.99/month or $59/year (3 devices); Team $129/year (10 devices). Billed by Dodo Payments.

## Online stores

- Seller storefronts live at `https://photozseo.com/store/<slug>`, with a marketplace index at `https://photozseo.com/market`. Store and product pages include schema.org Product, Store, Organization and BreadcrumbList data.
